description: Search transcripts of the Entra.Chat podcast (Merill Fernando's Microsoft Entra podcast on YouTube) using natural language or keywords. Returns transcript excerpts with episode metadata, guest names, and timestamped YouTube deep links that start playback at the relevant moment. Hybrid mode fuses BM25 keyword search with semantic vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (semantic requires OPENAI_API_KEY; keyword works with no configuration).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (default), semantic-only, or keyword-only (BM25)

query.description: Natural language question or keywords to search for

name: search_entra_podcasts
